acceptanceJudgements.bullet: Unknown privileged fields are rejected; external DTOs contain no internal provenance.
acceptanceJudgements.evidence: tests/contracts/schemas.test.ts injects injectedAuthority into all 9 architecture schemas (manifest, envelope, submission, permit, feedback, intent, plan, attempt, result) and every parse fails; composition.test.ts rejects privateRevision/approvalActor/family/internalIntent/modelPrompt/role and a nested workUnit command; projectPublicListing is a positive allowlist asserting the exact key set, absence of workUnits, and throws on a privateLogs canary; PublicFeedbackSchema rejects privateLogs, private jobKind and rawMessage; SubmissionEnvelopeSchema rejects client actorId.

acceptanceJudgements.bullet: Identical canonical content hashes identically; one-byte changes invalidate its digest; path collisions are rejected.
acceptanceJudgements.evidence: packages/contracts/hash.ts canonicalizes json-sorted-utf8/v1 with recursive key sort, preserved array order, and rejects non-JSON values, cycles, sparse/extended arrays and accessors (canonical-array.test.ts proves getters are never invoked); paths.test.ts asserts an independently known SHA-256 vector which the reviewer recomputed outside the suite (sha256 of the 5 canonical bytes '"abc"' = 6cc43f858fbb763301637b5af970e2a46b46f461f27e5a0f41e009c59b827b25, matching the assertion); hash sensitivity test shows one changed byte/hash/terms/policy binding changes the manifest digest; paths.test.ts and the manifest asset test reject exact, case-folded and file/directory collisions; PortablePathSchema rejects traversal, drive/UNC/device/ADS/NUL/backslash/trailing-dot/space cases.

acceptanceJudgements.bullet: Single-unit, frontend+backend and frontend+backend+policy contracts validate; conflicting path/schema ownership, dangling links and unknown capabilities are rejected.
acceptanceJudgements.evidence: composition.test.ts parses single-unit, full-stack and full-stack+policy fixtures and rejects 15 named invalid scenarios (duplicate_ids, shared_paths, case_paths, dangling_interface, unknown_capability shell, unsupported_version, missing_capability, schema_owner, missing_e2e, partial_e2e, cyclic_start, uncovered_requirement, missing_interface_check, tooling_edit, executable_policy); graph-hardening.test.ts additionally rejects a disconnected policy unit, non-participating interface declaration, mixed versions of one schema, and candidate-editable published interface schemas; the 'family' exclusive discriminator field is rejected.
